description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, which manages a user interface with a fragment, menu options, and logging setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages the main UI, including fragment transactions and logging setup, extending SampleActivityBase.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets content view, and loads the DrawableTintingFragment if first created.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu, toggling visibility and title based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, particularly toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain including LogWrapper, MessageOnlyLogFilter, and LogFragment.
